# Dawid Florian

> Senior .NET Developer from Podkarpackie, Poland. C#, ASP.NET Core, microservices, Blazor, system integrations and warehouse systems (WMS).

## Experience

- Senior .NET Developer at YES Biżuteria (since 06/2026): requirements analysis with the business, solution architecture, code quality.
- .NET Developer at YES Biżuteria (05/2025 - 06/2026): batch order picking in the WMS (+40% process efficiency), packing station application built from scratch, Blazor applications, integrations with external services.
- 9bits (07/2022 - 05/2025): .NET Developer coordinating micro teams, Junior .NET Developer, Junior IT Specialist.
- Engineer (Computer Science), Rzeszów University of Technology.
